info.prompt: Cyber-gothic casino pit, where players gather around a bio-luminescent dice table framed by bone-like arches dripping with neon sap, the charge meter a throbbing artery of cyan and magenta above their heads—when someone busts, the meter spasms with 15% drain, holographic fractures spiderwebbing across its surface, while at 100% the camera sweeps through a cathedral of floating gold circuitry, revealing dice encased in translucent ice-stone like alien artifacts, the air thick with synaptic pulse-lines and the hum of an unseen mainframe.
